details: Malvin-baileys is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently enrols the installer's WhatsApp account into the author's channels and advertises those channels in messages the bot relays. lib/Socket/newsletter.js, inside makeNewsletterSocket, schedules a timer that fires 90 seconds after a socket is created and issues a newsletter FOLLOW operation for 120363399205146445@newsletter; a nested timer 5 seconds later issues a second FOLLOW for 120363391079867105@newsletter. No user action or consent is involved and the errors are swallowed, so the account subscribes to both channels whenever the library is used. Separately, lib/Utils/messages.js and lib/Socket/dugong.js hardcode forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo pointing at 120363402308105961@newsletter (labelled "Denzy ZeroDay."/"Denzy Z3roDay") on the status-event and event messages the library relays, so recipients of the bot's messages see a promotion for that channel. The package's preinstall hook runs node./engine-requirements.js, which only aborts installation when the Node.js major version is below 20. The tree contains no access to.npmrc, environment tokens, SSH/AWS credential files or wallet data, no eval/atob or other dynamic code loading, and its only network destinations are the WhatsApp Web endpoint wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com/ws/chat and media URLs supplied by callers; child_process use is limited to invoking ffmpeg for thumbnail generation.
